title: MyLinden Help: Prompt-Pay Rate on Charges Added to a Patient Payment Plans Plan
content:
**Does a charge added to my Patient Payment Plans plan keep a prompt-pay rate?**

The add-on prompt-pay rate is the full prompt-pay discount percentage of your Patient Financial Account when the charge is added no more than the account's prompt-pay window, in calendar days, after its posting date and the account keeps a card on file; half of it when the charge is added within that window and the account keeps no card on file; and 0 once more than the prompt-pay window's days have passed since posting.

**Whose figures are the window and the percentage?** Both are set by the financial class of the Patient Financial Account: the prompt-pay window in calendar days counted from the charge's posting date, and the prompt-pay discount percentage.

**How does the rate act?** The counted amount of the add-on is multiplied by one minus the add-on prompt-pay rate divided by 100, without intermediate rounding.

| Days from posting to the add-on | Card on file on the Patient Financial Account | Add-on prompt-pay rate |
|---|---|---|
| No more than the account's prompt-pay window | Yes | The full prompt-pay discount percentage |
| No more than the account's prompt-pay window | No | Half of the prompt-pay discount percentage |
| More than the account's prompt-pay window | Either | 0 |

**Example (hypothetical 30-day window and a percentage of 7.50).** A charge posted on 2 June and added on 2 July is added 30 days after posting, inside the window. With a card on file the rate is 7.50 and a counted amount of 400.00 is multiplied by 0.925, giving 370.00; with no card on file the rate is 3.75 and the amount is multiplied by 0.9625, giving 385.00. Added on 3 July, 31 days after posting, the rate is 0.
